newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Automatic to post 95 mln yen special loss.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Automatic to post 95 mln yen special loss.

text.p: Tokyo Automatic Machinery Works Ltd said on Monday that it would post an extraordinary loss of about 95 million yen this business year to complete the liquidation of its U.S. unit Package Machinery Co.
Tokyo Automatic, a Japanese packaging machinery maker, said in a statement that it would cover the special loss by selling securities holdings.

Tokyo Automatic said in November that it expected to post a parent current profit of 300 million yen in fiscal 1996/97 ending March 31, compared with an actual current profit of 269 million yen in 1995/96.
It also said it expected a parent net profit of 150 million yen for 1996/97, compared with a profit of 113 million yen last business year.
